surfaces.name: SEC EDGAR filing/accession universe

probes.rule: First fixed Phase2 fixture in its original manifest order; no new issuer or outcome selection

surfaces.reason: Existing original-byte accession archive, offline parser and metadata lineage; form enumeration separates source from eventual financial outcomes

surfaces.name: Federal Register document/publication register

probes.rule: First page, at most2 records, fixed2019-01-02 publication-day slice; no company/outcome/agency filter

surfaces.reason: Official date/document/agency register with mechanically defined publication-day denominator, independently of corporate success

surfaces.name: ClinicalTrials.gov study register

probes.rule: First page at most2 current registry studies in source LastUpdatePostDate ascending order; no status/sponsor/therapeutic/outcome filter

surfaces.reason: Official stable study IDs, sponsor/status/date fields and broad registered-study panel; current-version versus historical-posting distinction is testable
